q_definition: forecast integrated realized variance / eSSVI theta
selection_note: 0.75 was the 2023-24 dev-only optimizer but failed 2025 and early 2026. 0.825 is an adaptive robustness selection: it maximizes the worst calendar-year mean return-on-risk across 2023, 2024 and 2025 among the tested stable candidates and remains positive in both 2026 slices. It is frozen operationally, but there is no untouched threshold-selection holdout remaining.
limitations: Frozen RV coefficients were not refit during threshold calibration.

Rolling ATM-relative archive supports exact 10:00 entry credit and terminal expiry payoff, but not exact fixed-contract interim recenter marks after large drift. Threshold selection therefore uses terminal PnL; recenter remains a management rule and is not used to select q.
2026 May-August had already been used to choose/freeze the RV architecture on QLIKE before threshold calibration; its option-PnL view is conditional evidence rather than a pristine joint holdout.
